message:
I once went to a family gathering with my go-bag in tow, just in case. My kids teased me, calling me the gloriously over-prepared grandma. I had snacks, a first-aid kit, and even a deck of cards for entertainment. 

As it turned out, the snacks became a hit during the game night, and the first-aid kit was useful when one of the little ones tripped and scraped their knee. I chuckled at their playful jabs, but I found comfort in knowing I was ready for anything. 

Sometimes, being a bit over-prepared can turn an ordinary day into a memorable one. Do you have your go-bag ready?
